typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFilename as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		dr_DealDate as string,
		Branch as string,
		Status as string,
		{I O} as string,
		Type as string,
		{Value Date} as string,
		{Deal no} as string,
		CCY as string,
		{Amount Bought} as string,
		Rate as string,
		{Amount Sold} as string,
		{Deal date} as string,
		{Customer BIC} as string,
		{Sender Ref} as string,
		{Customer Name} as string,
		{Date Confirmation Received} as string,
		{Trade Date aging } as string,
		Comments as string,
		SoldCCY as string,
		{Aging confirmation} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(Loaddate = toString(currentTimestamp()),
		Filename = toString($sFilename)) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		BRANCH as string,
		Sold_CCY as string,
		Customer_Name as string,
		VALUEDATE as string,
		Date_Confirm_Received as string,
		RATE as string,
		Comments as string,
		IO as string,
		Confirmation_Aging as string,
		Amount_Bought as string,
		Bought_CCY as string,
		Filename as string,
		Trade_Date_Aging as string,
		DEALDATE as string,
		CUSTBIC as string,
		dr_Dealdate as string,
		STATUS as string,
		Amount_Sold as string,
		Loaddate as string,
		DEALNO as string,
		TYPE as string,
		SENDERREF as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		BRANCH = Branch,
		Sold_CCY = SoldCCY,
		Customer_Name = {Customer Name},
		VALUEDATE = {Value Date},
		Date_Confirm_Received = {Date Confirmation Received},
		RATE = Rate,
		Comments,
		IO = {I O},
		Confirmation_Aging = {Aging confirmation},
		Amount_Bought = {Amount Bought},
		Bought_CCY = CCY,
		Filename,
		Trade_Date_Aging = {Trade Date aging },
		DEALDATE = {Deal date},
		CUSTBIC = {Customer BIC},
		dr_Dealdate = dr_DealDate,
		STATUS = Status,
		Amount_Sold = {Amount Sold},
		Loaddate,
		DEALNO = {Deal no},
		TYPE = Type,
		SENDERREF = {Sender Ref}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
